page.layout: One printed title page, full width, centred lines from top to bottom. A library stamp (oval, upper right and mid right), a Jesuit library seal (lower left) and a printer's woodcut ornament (crown and device, centre right) are not printed text and are left out.

main_text.l: Omnia in unum volumen redegit atque secundam hanc Editionem variis
additamentis locupletiorem accuravit, nec non Græca, qua Græce
minus gnaros tardare potuissent, Latinè vertit.

page.notes: The "IOSEPHI" line begins with a decorative swash capital I. The "ARNHEMIÆ," line sits above a rule. Stamps and seals are not transcribed.
